name: camera_shift_outboard_pinch
hypothesis: An 18 mm camera shift toward negative x makes the unchanged calibration report the plate approximately 18 mm farther outward. Radius fitting can still pass. The shortened drag leaves about 27 mm overhang, but the subsequent pinch remains biased outward.
expected_failure: Step 5 can pass its overhang check yet pinch beyond the actual rim, failing to establish a grasp and subsequently failing the held-plate check.
real_world_story: Cleaning nudges the camera along its mounting bracket without changing the robot's stored calibration.
